adoctra-semantic-probes.source: Original probes of the semantic comparison contract; not upstream tests.

upstream.test: attribute set via API overrides attribute set in document
upstream.adaptation: Append ifdef/ifndef paragraphs to observe the cash attribute asserted by the Ruby test. Pass the original string host override via CLI; Ruby nil/false/true API variants are outside this string-only adapter. This additional profile compares inline semantic nodes and the explicitly selected header/final attributes instead of HTML; source inputs and resources are unchanged.
